head: 5bcfd8d2
headSubject: fix(crud): REG-308 residue -- claim the row before an update flow when kernel control is off
summary: REG-308 residue closed and pushed (5bcfd8d2): a concept with an update flow and crud.kernelControlled off now claims the row (GeneratedCrudRuntimeSupport.claimRowForUpdate, a CAS rewrite of the loaded row, skipped when the request has no version) before the flow runs. Guarded by ServiceBaseUpdateFlowRowClaimTest (generated output) plus runtime-support unit tests, not a booted probe: crud.kernelControlled is read app-wide (GeneratorFacade, SettingTarget.app()), so a probe on a per-concept override passed even with the fix removed and was reverted.
nextStep: Only OWN-2 (owner outreach) and AIP-4 4.5 (needs Tauri/Rust toolchain) remain open and neither is startable without the owner. Optional: verify and file a ledger item that a per-concept 'concept:X': {crud.kernelControlled:false} override in config.json is ignored by generation (generate dsl-conformance-max with it on a concept and grep that concept's ServiceBase for checkCrudPermission; UnenforceableAccessRuleCheck checks it per concept while GeneratorFacade passes one app-level boolean to ServiceEmitter). Also watch fl-monitor-reports-compensated-execution (20-flow.json) for a recurrence of its single InMemory flake.
verified: run-all-gates -IncludePaperwork: 5/5 green (generator, runtimeHost, kernel, aiKnowledge, weeklyPaperwork); InMemory behaviour probes 136/136 with the claim in place; new generator test 3/3 and VersionConflictTest 7/7. Not verified: the new generator test was not run red against a template with the claim removed (the h2local and InMemory probe red-checks were inconclusive, see summary).
